UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Private per-user document storing household profile, app preferences, up to 5 saved Indian locations, alert preferences, FCM tokens, and notification history.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

profile.description: Household type, commute mode/duration, outdoor habits, health sensitivities, home setup, and optional indoor PM2.5.

preferences.description: Versioned v2 app preferences (language, units, theme, accessibility, advice style, tour state).

savedLocations.description: Up to 5 saved Indian locations with per-location alert toggles.

alertPrefs.description: Notification thresholds, quiet hours, morning briefing time, daily cap, and sensitive mode.

alertState.description: Deduplication and cooldown tracking state per location.

fcmTokens.description: Up to 10 registered Web Push FCM tokens for this user.

notificationHistory.description: Recent up to 50 notification records for this user.

createdAt.description: Immutable account document creation server timestamp.

/users/{uid}.description: Strict owner-only user profile, preferences, saved locations, and alert settings document.
